name: Domain of Rhodes
alt: Lord of Rhodes and the Cyclades

predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: Rhodes, which 'had slipped out of imperial Byzantine control' before or during the Fourth Crusade (1203-04)

successors.name: Empire of Nicaea
successors.text: Rhodes, 'a province of the Nicaean state' after the Genoese were evicted

wars.name: Nicaean expedition against Rhodes
wars.outcome: Vatatzes sent an expedition under Andronikos Palaiologos, supervised by the emperor; 'The island was ravaged, but Leo apparently stayed in effective control'.

wars.name: Genoese seizure of Rhodes and Nicaean recovery
wars.outcome: The Genoese seized the island in 1248 and held it until the Nicaeans evicted them (1250); Rhodes became a Nicaean province and the Gabalas domain ended.

certainty.note: An island domain: the coast is its border, but the pages name no other island of the 'Cyclades' and Aegean islands the lord claimed in 1234, so the extent beyond Rhodes is unknown.
